# Agent Harnesses

By Rolling Edition, with AI · **In practice** · [Read it free online](https://rollingedition.com/agent-harnesses)

[![The latest edition's stamp](https://rollingedition.com/agent-harnesses/stamp.svg)](https://rollingedition.com/agent-harnesses) [![Checks](https://github.com/rollingedition/book-agent-harnesses/actions/workflows/checks.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rollingedition/book-agent-harnesses/actions/workflows/checks.yml)

Build the code around a model that makes an agent you can trust with real tools: the loop, tools, context, permissions, sandboxing, subagents and tests, on a maintenance agent for a small Python library.

**Written with AI. Verified by people.** [How we make books](https://rollingedition.com/policies/editorial) · [Check a copy](https://rollingedition.com/check)

## Who it's for

For engineers who have called a model's API and built a demo agent, and now must make an agent that works on real tools without a person watching every step. Writes Python and knows JSON and HTTP. No model internals or MCP background needed.

## Run the examples

Every example runs offline, in a pinned environment, and its output must match the book's. With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```sh
uv venv --python 3.12.15
uv pip install -r examples/requirements.txt
cd examples && ../.venv/bin/python read-the-issue.py
```

Model outputs are recorded once in `examples/data/recorded/`, each folder with a `manifest.json` that names the model, its exact version and the script that recorded it, so the examples never call a model. `recordings/` holds the scripts that record them again.

Where the data comes from, and its licence: [`examples/data/case/README.md`](examples/data/case/README.md).

## How this book stays current

When a library this book uses releases a new version, the examples that use it run again in the new version, and every example runs again each week. Agents draft any fix and check every change, and a change merges once its checks pass; one with a serious risk, such as a security or copyright problem, waits for a Rolling Edition maintainer. Anyone can check the book or correct it with a pull request. Each new edition is stamped with its date, its examples passing and what changed. [See what changed in each edition](https://rollingedition.com/agent-harnesses/changes).
